timing_scope.single_tile: 已在GPU的1xCx16x16输入，每个trial只执行一次net(tile)
timing_scope.model_only: 整图858个tile，batch=1，输入预先放入GPU，不含上采样/argmax/拼接
timing_scope.full_gpu_pipeline: 输入预先放入GPU，网络前向+双线性上采样+argmax+整图拼接
timing_scope.excluded: 磁盘读取、checkpoint加载、PCA预处理和画图
timing_scope.execution_type: PyTorch QAT fake-quant CUDA operators; not TensorRT INT8 and not FPGA
